title: Main Street Michelin Mile Food Tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour stands out because it offers a truly unique and immersive culinary journey where you get to experience three Michelin-rated restaurants in one unforgettable evening. You'll taste contemporary Canadian cuisine at Published on Main, ranked 28th in North America, explore the exceptional sushi artistry at the Michelin Bib Gourmand Sushi Hil, and finish with bold Vietnamese-inspired dishes and rotating desserts at Good Thief. This combination hits all the highlights of Vancouver’s diverse and acclaimed food scene in a single, walkable experience guided by an expert who knows the city’s hidden gems. The tour perfectly balances exclusive high-end dining with local stories and vibrant atmosphere, making it the ultimate way for you to savour the best the city has to offer in one night. It's not just a food tour—it's a curated adventure through Vancouver's top culinary treasures that you won’t find anywhere else.
